ITEM 1 | Scattered cluster of about 30 tan-brown oval pieces with pointed ends, matte dry surface with fine ridges, some whole and some split in half, spread over about 9 x 8 cm on the left-center of the plate | 35
ITEM 2 | Single whole round fruit about 8 cm across, glossy smooth skin with red blush over yellow-green background, small dark stem cavity on top, sitting on the lower-center of the plate | 180
ITEM 3 | Seven small glossy red oval pieces about 2 to 2.5 cm long with smooth taut skin, clustered on the right side beside and below the apple | 55
